usedFor: Woodpecker runs outreach campaigns, and Hastewire rewrites text when “Prospect Interested” runs “Humanize Text”.

bestTemplate.name: “Prospect Interested” in Woodpecker, then “Humanize Text” in Hastewire
bestTemplate.why: A prospect showing interest can trigger a natural-sounding rewrite of your reply.

watchOut: “Prospect Autoreplied” also fires when you mark a prospect AUTOREPLIED by hand.
